answers.goal: I want to become an actor and a director. I want to be seen on the big screen and I want my films to be shown.
answers.drew: Ever since I was born, I’ve been drawn to entertainment and performing. It all started when I forced my cousins to be in my iMovies. Later, I became a film major in college, where I had the opportunity to work with inspiring producers like Molly Asher and Diane Martel. Working with industry professionals gave me a glimpse into what my life could be, and I fell in love with it.
